versions.content: When PduR_J1939DcmTransmit returns anything but E_OK, or wh en J1939Dcm_TpTxConfirmation or J1939Dcm_TxConfirmation reports E_NOT_OK, the J1939Dcm shall retry the failed transmission from the next main function.

When PduR_J 1939DcmTransmit returns anything but E_OK, or when J1939Dcm_TpTxConfirmation or J1939Dcm_TxConfirmation reports Specification of a Diagnostic Communication Manager for SAE J1939 AUTOSAR CP R20 - 11 20 of 101 Document ID 610 : AUTOSAR_SWS_SAEJ1939DiagnosticCommunicationManager E_NOT_OK, the J1939Dcm shall retry the failed transmission from the next main function.

When PduR_J1939DcmTransmit returns anything but E_OK, or when J1939Dcm_TpTxConfirmation or J1939Dcm_TxConfirmation reports Specification of a Diagnostic Communication Manager for SAE J1939 AUTOSAR CP R21 - 11 20 of 100 Document ID 610 : AUTOSAR_SWS_SAEJ1939DiagnosticCommunicationManager E_NOT_OK, the J1939Dcm shall retry the failed transmission from the next main function.
